data.reason: Fourth review, four findings, all about what the triage claims and what the task tells the reviewer to skip. H1: the task says read the focus set and no others, but the journal can never be in a focus set because changed_files drops everything under FINGERPRINT_EXCLUDED, and the ticket file can be dropped from one at spot depth, so the reviewer would be told not to read the two things a review is against. H2: red_before_green reports settled when kpi.red_before_green proves only that the cited check exited non-zero, never that it failed for the reason the slice states, and the task then tells the reviewer not to spend a read confirming it; this ticket has already had that exact failure, found at record 33 and resolved without code. H3: acceptance_entries passes on a count while its detail reads as one check per criterion. H4 is resolved without code: the log cannot tell one subagent from another, so the figure counts every subagent in the review round, and that is recorded rather than renamed.
